title: The release workflow shape scales with the releaseMode dimension
asA: operator declaring a release path on delivery-ci-workflows v2
iWant: the release workflow the materialiser produces to scale with what my project has already declared (no release, tag only, tag plus artefact, or handoff to deploy)
soThat: I choose the maturity level of my release path once and the workflow set follows

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `workflowShape.releaseMode` is `none`, the workflow-materialiser writes no `release` workflow file to the provider's workflow path. A project with no release path does not ship a workflow. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.then: no `release` workflow file is created at the provider's workflow path and no `.rcf/reports/ci/release.json` file is written

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `releaseMode` is `tagOnly`, the release workflow fires on a release trigger and creates a release entity on the CI provider's own release surface. No artefact-publish step ships. When `tagPlusArtefact`, the release workflow additionally runs the project-realised artefact-publish step and uploads its output to the release entity. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the workflowShape elicits (checkSet, branchModel, releaseMode, scheduledAudit, providerHint); the AC substitutes the project's declaration for the illustrative shape values.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a `workflowShape` with `releaseMode: tagPlusArtefact` and a realised artefact-publish step
acceptanceCriteria.then: the release workflow creates the release entity, runs the artefact-publish step, uploads the published artefact to the release entity, and records the just-published version identifier in the aggregate report

acceptanceCriteria.description: The release workflow does not include the required check set. Its aggregate report at `.rcf/reports/ci/release.json` carries the release-flow outcome (tag creation, artefact publish, optional deploy handoff) and not the gate-runner outcome.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a release workflow materialised in any non-`none` mode
acceptanceCriteria.then: the release workflow does not invoke the gate-runner entry point and the `pipeline.json` at the same commit remains the record of the check set outcome

acceptanceCriteria.description: A failed release entity creation step (a tag write refused, a release API rejection, a permissions error) fails the release aggregate with a stable-coded RELEASE_CREATE_FAILED naming the step and the provider response; downstream publication and promote steps do not run. Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent supplies the elicited providerHint and releaseMode; the AC substitutes them for the illustrative GHA / tagOnly.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a release workflow at releaseMode=tagOnly with the provider forced to return 4xx on the tag write
acceptanceCriteria.then: the release aggregate is failed with RELEASE_CREATE_FAILED naming the create step and the provider status; no downstream publication step runs; the workflow exit code is non-zero
